en: Hall of the Garden of Perfect Brightness
relation: first (southern) hall of the island axis, directly north of the Front Lake 前湖 (湖正北); 奉三无私殿 behind it
built: by 1709 (garden plaque given by Kangxi; S05 j80:1b)
changed: burned 1836 (丙申九月二十六日) with the other two axis halls, rebuilt to the old form in under a year (E1134)
basis: 正大光明後有湖亦稱前湖湖正北為圓明園殿五楹 ... 前第一層殿恭懸聖祖御書圓明園額. Faces not written; south toward the Front Lake is my reading of the axis

en: Hall of the Three Selfless Virtues
relation: second hall of the axis (第二層), behind 圆明园殿, in front of 九洲清晏殿
changed: burned 1836, rebuilt 1837 (E1134); Daoguang held the clan banquet of the 14th of the first month here (S202 j13)
basis: 後為奉三無私殿七楹 ... 第二層為奉三無私殿

en: Hall of the Nine Continents Clear and Calm
relation: third and northern hall of the axis (又後), behind 奉三无私殿; 天地一家春 to its east, 乐安和 to its west; Malone has it facing the Back Lake (S02 pp.77-79, E1153)
built: plaque 九州清宴 in Yongzheng's hand (世宗御書)
changed: burned 1836, rebuilt 1837 (E1134); a 抱厦 added at some date (Yangshi Lei E1162)
basis: 又後為九州清宴殿七楹 ... 九州清宴額世宗御書四十景之一也

en: Spring for Heaven, Earth and One Family
relation: east of 九洲清晏殿 (東為天地一家春)
changed: 1873 decree renames it 承恩堂 and gives the name 天地一家春 to 敷春堂 in 万春园 (E1135); plan S01 writes 承恩堂 (row YM03-N06)
basis: 東為天地一家春

relation: west of 九洲清晏殿 (西為樂安和); 清晖阁 further west
changed: by 1774 the plaque of the emperor's sleeping hall (寢殿); the 1774 preface says the room he lived in was formerly called 隨安堂
basis: 西為樂安和; 顔寢殿之額曰樂安和; (舊額所居書室曰隨安堂)

relation: west of 乐安和 (又西為清暉閣); 露香斋 in front of it; faces a long stone wall (石壁) across a court
changed: by 1765 the tall pines before it had burned; small buildings 松云楼, 露香斋, 涵德书屋, 茹古堂 were added round it (E1094)
basis: 又西為清暉閣; 閣前喬松已燬石壁獨存

relation: in front of 清晖阁 (閣前為露香齋), by a rockery with trees (假山有真樹)
built: c.1765, one of the buildings added after the pines burned (E1094)
basis: 閣前為露香齋; 1765 poem: 假山有真樹 ... (右露香齋)

relation: left of 露香斋 (左為茹古堂); a book room against the rock (巖堂 ... 所貯惟縹緗)
basis: 左為茹古堂; 巖堂何所貯所貯惟縹緗

relation: newly built on the high ground of the stone wall that faces 清晖阁 (閣對横陳石壁修因高新築兩層樓), near the surviving pines outside the wall
basis: 閣對横陳石壁修因高新築兩層樓 ... (閣前松遭燬牆外者猶存喬柯此樓近之因以命名)

relation: right of 露香斋 (右為涵徳書屋); a very small study (書屋剛容方丈寛)
basis: 右為涵徳書屋; 書屋剛容方丈寛

relation: west road of the island (table YM03-11)
built: 1831 (道光十一年), with the Daoguang emperor's essay 慎德堂记 (E1130)
basis: E1130: Daoguang's essay on thrift for the hall, spring 1831

relation: south front of the garden at the north end of the carriage road 輦道, with the Front Lake (扇面湖) east and west of the road; five-bay court offices left and right before it
basis: 大宫門五楹門前左右朝房各五楹; 大宫門前輦道東西皆有湖是為前湖; the gate plaque is Yongzheng's hand: 園額 ... 懸大宫門者世宗御書. Faces S: the road comes from the south (E2114)

relation: before the gate, one each side of the road (門前左右)
basis: 門前左右朝房各五楹

relation: north-east of the east lane's silver vault (又東北為南書房), outside the east 如意門 (S202 j4)
changed: 1801 (嘉慶辛酉): a further four-bay room inside the memorial gate next to the Grand Council office; the old lodging kept for collating books (S202 j4, E2124)
basis: 東夾道内為銀庫又東北為南書房; S202 j4: 圓明園之南書房舊在東如意門外

en: Gate of the Worthy and Good Going In and Out
relation: the second palace gate (二宫門), inside 大宫门; duty rooms left and right; a moon-shaped canal with three stone bridges before it; two side gates 罩門 east and west
basis: 大宫門内為出入賢良門五楹門左右為直房前跨石橋 ... 出入賢良門額世宗御書是為二宫門凡武職侍衛引見御此門較射 ... 東西設兩罩門 ... 門前河形如月中駕石橋三

en: three stone bridges before 出入贤良门
relation: over the moon-shaped canal before the second gate; water from the west running east to the sluice at 如意门
basis: 門前河形如月中駕石橋三其水自西來東注如意門閘口㑹東園各河而出

relation: east and west, across the bridges before 出入贤良门 (度橋東西朝房各五楹)
basis: 度橋東西朝房各五楹

en: Hall of the Upright and Bright
relation: inside 出入贤良门; five-bay side halls east and west; 寿山殿 behind; 洞明堂 to the east; a rock cliff behind
built: 1725 (Yongzheng; S05 j80:2b 構殿于園之南御以聴政); plaque one of Yongzheng's fourteen four-character plaques
changed: 月台 with four censers added 1775-1793 (S119, in params.json); Malone's foundation 129 x 63 x 4 ft is in params.json (S02 p.75, E1009)
basis: 出入賢良門内為正大光明殿七楹東西配殿各五楹後為壽山殿東為洞明堂; 世宗御題四字額者凡十有四正大光明殿其一也

relation: either side of the court before 正大光明殿
basis: 東西配殿各五楹

relation: east of 正大光明殿
built: plaque in Yongzheng's hand (世宗御書額)
changed: used for the review of capital sentences (勾到) when the court was in the garden (S202 j6, E1034)
basis: 東為洞明堂世宗御書額

relation: east of 正大光明殿 (正大光明殿東為勤政親賢正殿); a rear bay (後楹) with its own plaque 為君難; side room 東書房 on the east
basis: 正大光明殿東為勤政親賢正殿五楹; 勤政殿額曰勤政親賢 ... 後楹額曰為君難皆世宗御書. Faces not written; S211 has the 東書房 door facing east. S211 says 三楹 against S05's 五楹: see question row

relation: east of 勤政殿 (勤政親賢之東為飛雲軒)
changed: Xianfeng kept mourning here from the first days of 1850 (S207, E1089)
basis: 勤政親賢之東為飛雲軒

relation: a 閣 east of 飛雲軒 (東有閣為靜鑑)
basis: 東有閣為靜鑑

relation: north of 静鉴阁 (其北為懷清芬)
basis: 其北為懐清芬

relation: further north (又北)
basis: 又北為秀木佳䕃

relation: turning behind 秀木佳荫 (轉後為生秋庭)
basis: 轉後為生秋庭

relation: east of 静鉴阁 (靜鑑閣東為芳碧叢)
basis: 靜鑑閣東為芳碧叢

relation: behind 芳碧丛 (後為保合太和正殿三楹), the eastern end of the scene; west warm room 西暖閣 with a second 勤政亲贤 plaque
basis: 後為保合太和正殿三楹; 1744 preface: 又東為保合太和秀石名葩庭軒明敞

relation: behind 保合太和殿 (後為富春樓); the lower storey carries the plaques 坐擁琳琅, 蔚然深秀, 無倦齋, 清風明月; 镂月开云 lies behind it (j80:26a)
basis: 後為富春樓; 富春樓下額曰坐擁琳琅曰蔚然深秀曰無倦齋曰清風明月. Two storeys from 樓 and 樓下

en: Clear Sound of the Bamboo Grove
relation: east of 富春楼 (樓東為竹林清響)
basis: 樓東為竹林清響

relation: gate on the south of the central island in the middle of 福海
basis: 蓬島瑶臺在福海中央門三楹南嚮 ... 門額曰鏡中閣 ... 皆御書

en: main hall, Penglai Isle and Jade Terrace
relation: behind the gate on the central island; 畅襟楼 east and 神洲三岛 west in front of it; 随安室 and 日日平安报好音 at its east and west sides
built: scene named 蓬萊洲 under Yongzheng, renamed in 1744 (S05 j80:10a, j82:16b)
basis: 正殿七楹 ... 舊名蓬萊洲後易今名額為皇上御書. Faces S by the gate's 南嚮, my reading

relation: in front of the main hall, east side (殿前東)
basis: 殿前東為暢襟樓; plaque in Qianlong's hand. Two storeys from 樓

en: Three Isles of the Divine Land
relation: in front of the main hall, west side (西為神洲三島)
basis: 西為神洲三島 ... 神洲三島 ... 諸額皆世宗御書

relation: east side (東偏)
basis: 東偏為隨安室; plaque in Qianlong's hand

relation: west side (西偏)
basis: 西偏為日日平安報好音

en: Pavilion of the Immortals' Hill in the Sea
relation: on the east island, over a bridge to the south-east of the central island
basis: 由蓬島瑶臺東南度橋為東島有亭為瀛海仙山

en: main building of the north island
relation: on the north island, over a bridge to the north-west of the central island
basis: 西北度橋為北島正宇三楹

relation: east of 四宜书屋, on the water (臨池), five bays on each floor; two archways south of it
basis: 四宜書屋之東臨池樓宇為方壺勝境上下各五楹南建坊座二; upper plaques 宜春殿 and 敬勝怠. Faces S by the archways to the south, my reading

plaque_zh: 芝田日永;閬苑春深;鳳鳴珠樹;鹿壽靈臺
relation: south of the front building (南建坊座二)
basis: 坊座南額曰芝田日永曰閬苑春深北曰鳯鳴珠樹曰鹿夀靈臺

relation: north of the front building (其北樓宇為噦鸞殿)
basis: 其北樓宇為噦鸞殿; 噦鸞殿樓宇上額曰用厥中曰有真賞在. Two storeys from 樓宇

relation: further north (又北為瓊華樓), behind 哕鸾殿
basis: 又北為瓊華樓; 瓊華樓額曰潄芳潤

relation: east of 哕鸾殿 (噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫); a gate 蕊珠宫门 in the garden wall (S05 j80:7a)
basis: 噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫

relation: south of 蕊珠宫 (宫南船塢)
basis: 宫南船塢

relation: behind the boathouse (後有龍王廟)
basis: 宫南船塢後有龍王廟

en: Pavilion of the Source of Literature
relation: a little west of north of 水木明瑟 (水木明瑟之北稍西); 柳浪闻莺 to its west; the rock 玲峰 in front; a stele pavilion to the east
built: 乾隆三十九年 1774 per S05 (params.json, from S134/S105, has 1775 on the site of 四达亭)
basis: 水木明瑟之北稍西為文源閣上下各六楹閣西為栁浪聞鶯 ... 文源閣乾隆三十九年建 ... 閣前石為玲峯. Six bays on each floor; faces S because the 玲峰 and pool stand 閣前, my reading

relation: in front of the library (閣前石為玲峯), in the pool; Qianlong's poem 文源閣詩 cut on it
built: brought from 大房山 by 1775 (御製玲峯歌 乾隆四十年)
basis: 閣前石為玲峯刋御製文源閣詩; 乾隆四十年御製玲峯歌 ... 萬鍾異石大房山

relation: east of the library (閣東亭内石碣), holding the stele with 御製文源閣記
basis: 閣東亭内石碣刋御製文源閣記

relation: north of 曲院风荷; front and rear storeyed buildings of five bays each, facing south onto the stage 清音阁
basis: 麴院風荷之北為同樂園前後樓各五楹南向其前為清音閣北向; S202 j13: 正屋凡五間, the emperor below, the consorts also watching (主位亦從觀焉)

relation: in front of (south of) the viewing buildings, facing north (其前為清音閣北向); 扮戏楼 to its south (S43)
basis: 其前為清音閣北向; S202 j13: 演劇臺深廣約十丈凡三層神祇仙佛由上一層縋而下鬼魅則自下一層穴而上

relation: east of the theatre court (東為永日堂)
basis: 東為永日堂; 永日堂 ... 諸額皆世宗御書

en: North-South Long Street, the shop street
relation: through the middle of the group (中有南北長街), with 抱朴草堂 on its west; north end over twin bridges to 舍卫城
built: by 1743 (Attiret's fair, E2160; this is the Yuanming Yuan street, not CC02-15 in Changchun Yuan, which was not yet built)
basis: 中有南北長街街西為抱樸草堂街北度雙橋為舎衛城; Malone p.95 caption: Shops line both sides of the street ... The New Year's Fair was held on this street

relation: west of the long street (街西為抱樸草堂)
basis: 街西為抱樸草堂

relation: at the north end of the street, crossing to 舍卫城 (街北度雙橋)
basis: 街北度雙橋為舎衛城; Malone p.94: crossed a bridge over a canal

relation: walled temple town north of the long street, over the twin bridges; three archways before it; 多宝阁 on the south face; inside a gate, then 寿国寿民殿, 仁慈殿, 普福宫; 最胜阁 on the north
built: 1740, being built at the same time as 方壶胜境 per 圆明园则例 vol. ii p.33 as cited by Malone (S02 p.94 n.45), where it is called 佛城
basis: 街北度雙橋為舎衛城前樹坊楔三城南面為多寳閣内為山門正殿為壽國壽民後為仁慈殿又後為普福宫城北為最勝閣. Faces S: the approach is from the street to the south, my reading

relation: on the south face of the city (城南面為多寳閣), shrine of 关帝
basis: 城南面為多寳閣; 多寳閣祀闗帝額曰至聖大勇. Faces S: the approach is from the street to the south, my reading

relation: main hall behind the inner gate (内為山門正殿為壽國壽民)
basis: 正殿為壽國壽民; 夀國夀民殿額曰心月妙相; 壽國壽民 ... 諸額皆世宗御書. Faces S: the approach is from the street to the south, my reading

relation: behind the main hall (後為仁慈殿)
basis: 後為仁慈殿; 仁慈殿額曰具足圓成. Faces S: the approach is from the street to the south, my reading

relation: behind 仁慈殿 (又後為普福宫)
basis: 又後為普福宫; 普福宫額曰瑞應優曇. Faces S: the approach is from the street to the south, my reading

relation: on the north of the city (城北為最勝閣), with an archway bearing 乾闼持轮 and 祗林垂鬘
basis: 城北為最勝閣; 最勝閣坊額曰乾闥持輪曰祗林垂鬘

relation: S05: south-east of 出入贤良门 beyond 清茶房 (東南為清茶房為軍機處); S202: inside 如意门, south of the palace canal, with the Manchu secretaries' room to its right and the Han secretaries' room in front
basis: 東南為清茶房為軍機處; 圆明园则如意门内，御河之南，为军机堂。堂之右，为满章京直房，其前为汉章京直房

en: east duty rooms of the boards
relation: behind the east court office before the gate: 宗人府, 内阁, 吏部, 礼部, 兵部, 都察院, 理藩院, 翰林院, 詹事府, 国子监, 銮仪卫 and the four eastern banners
basis: 其後東為宗人府内閣吏部禮部兵部都察院理藩院翰林院詹事府國子監鑾儀衛東四旗各衙門直房

en: west duty rooms of the boards
relation: to the west: 户部, 刑部, 工部, 钦天监, 内务府, 光禄寺, 通政司, 大理寺, 鸿胪寺, 太常寺, 太仆寺, 御书处, 上驷院, 武备院 and the four western banners
basis: 西為户部刑部工部欽天監内務府光禄寺通政司大理寺鴻臚寺太常寺太僕寺御書處上駟院武備院西四旗各衙門直房

relation: inside the east lane 东夹道
basis: 東夾道内為銀庫

basis: 東南為檔案房

basis: 西夾道之西南為造辦處

basis: 又南為藥房

relation: south-east of 出入贤良门, before the Grand Council (東南為清茶房為軍機處)
basis: 東南為清茶房

relation: south-west of 出入贤良门; its eunuchs used the west side gate 西罩门
basis: 西南為茶膳房 ... 茶膳房太監人等由西罩門出入

relation: further west of the kitchen (再西為繙書房)
basis: 再西為繙書房

relation: behind (north of) 正大光明殿 (後為壽山殿), by the rock hill 寿山
basis: 後為壽山殿

basis: 西北為春雨軒 (S05 j81:1a)

basis: 西北室為抑齋 [j81:1a]

basis: 又西為翠微堂 [j81:1a]
